name: Crozdesk

sources.title: Homepage — 'List your product on Crozdesk / Apply to list your software'; free listing CTA plus Vendor links (Become a Vendor, Vendor Login, Claim a Listing, Vendor Policy)
About — 'List your software products on Crozdesk free of charge'; Vendor Portal; Apply to List / Claim a Listing paths
Crozdesk blog — vendor application flow: apply, verify, vendor account created, complete listing in portal, reviewed and approved usually within 48 hours
Claim a Listing — claim an existing unmanaged listing; asks for a professional email, ideally on the same domain as the listing

requirements: B2B/business software products — the directory spans ~384 business software categories
Vendor must apply for a listing; the Crozdesk team verifies the application and creates a vendor account
If a listing already exists, use 'Claim a Listing' with a professional email — ideally on the same domain as the software listing
Listing is free; paid promotion campaigns exist as an optional add-on in the vendor portal
preparation: Product name and live public URL
Software category / business function mapping for the ~384 categories
Product description, logo, and screenshots (not strictly required but recommended)
Professional/work email — preferably matching the product domain
workflow: Check whether the product already has a listing; if yes use https://crozdesk.com/claims/new instead
Otherwise open the vendor application page (Apply to list your software — vendor portal at vendors.crozdesk.com) and complete the short application form
Wait for the team to verify the application and create the vendor account
Log in to the vendor portal, complete the listing with full product information, and submit
Team reviews and approves — usually within ~48 hours per the Crozdesk blog
Manage the listing afterwards via the vendor portal
watchFor: The batch's submission URL (vendor.revleads.com) does not match the current vendor portal (vendors.crozdesk.com) — use the crozdesk.com 'Apply to list your software' entry point
Paid 'promote your software' campaigns are offered inside the portal — the listing itself is free
Claim flow requires proving authority over an existing listing; use a matching-domain email
The batch's link claim was nofollow; actual link type on a live listing was not verified
countsAsLive: A public product profile page exists on crozdesk.com in a software category, indexed in the directory with user review capability
unknowns: Exact fields of the vendor application form
Whether free listings' outbound links are dofollow
Whether verification ever rejects applicants and on what grounds
